public_mechanism.family: Deficit Round Robin / weighted deficit round robin
public_mechanism.primary_source: Shreedhar and Varghese, Efficient Fair Queueing using Deficit Round Robin, Washington University technical report 1994 / IEEE-ACM TON 1996
source_supported_core: DRR is a fair-queueing approximation designed for fair resource share
a queue receives a quantum of service per round
unused service credit is carried into the next round rather than discarded
weighted DRR assigns different weights/quantums to provide weighted throughput
public_mechanism.adaptation: Represent each role-local work class as a durable queue with a small integer quantum and a persisted service-entitlement counter. Repository state is transport only; no network device, hosted scheduler, or external timer is required.

scope_limit: Constructed two-class four-slot role-local scheduling trace only. This does not prove arbitrary starvation bounds, network QoS guarantees, or DRR fairness under all variable-cost work distributions.
exact_next_action: After independent readback, advance once with credit_delta=1.
